meta.illustrativeNote: Illustrative data. This demonstration is not connected to Karnataka Government systems. Accident files do not name injured persons.
meta.jurisdictionNote: These records cover factories, boilers and other establishments on the Factories & Boilers list. They do not cover every construction site or every construction worker in the State.
meta.separationNote: Registered factories and other regulated establishments are separate lists. An active establishment is not the same count as a registered factory.
meta.stageNote: Inspections conducted and inspections still pending are separate. A violation stays open until a closure is recorded. Accident events, injuries and fatalities are separate counts. Boiler registration, inspection and certification are separate.
